theme: Fill the new profiles, get the first followers, and own GITEX Global week
notes: The plan, checklist and GITEX shot list are in social/campaigns/launch-2026.md. kit.title: Your personal LinkedIn post (Monday 16 Nov, after the page's launch carousel)
kit.note: Post it from your own profile within an hour of the page's 08:30 post, and reshare the page's carousel underneath. Edit the first line so it sounds like you.
kit.text:
I've been building Robotics MENA: a free, verified database of robots doing real work across the Middle East & North Africa. Today it goes social.

What's in it so far:
▸ 174 robotics companies with a sourced presence in the region
▸ 66 deployments, each with a primary source and a date
▸ Policy profiles and national targets for 11 countries
▸ 39 events

A few things the data already shows:
▸ The UAE leads with 26 deployments, then Saudi Arabia (17) and Egypt (6)
▸ Hospitals are the biggest buyer: 17 of the 66 deployments are in healthcare
▸ Dubai has 160+ self-driving vehicles registered, with a target of 4,000 by 2030

Every Monday we publish 5 verified signals, in English and Arabic.

If you work with robots in the region and we've missed you, tell me. Listing is free and can't be bought.

Follow the page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/roboticsmena/

#Robotics #MENA #UAE #SaudiArabia

kit.title: Message to the companies and operators we feature
kit.channel: LinkedIn message or email from contact@roboticsmena.com
kit.note: Send it the day their post goes out, to a press, marketing or partnerships contact. Fill in the [[brackets]]. Send it once per company; no follow-up chasing.
kit.text:
Hi [[first name]],

We've just launched Robotics MENA, a free and independent database of robots working across the Middle East & North Africa, with a primary source for every record.

Best,
[[your name]]

kit.title: LinkedIn page invites
kit.channel: LinkedIn page admin view → Grow → Invite to follow
kit.note: The credits reset monthly, so use them all on 16 Nov and again on 1 Dec.
kit.text:
Who to invite first (1st-degree connections only):
1. People working in robotics, automation, drones or autonomous vehicles in MENA
2. Operators that buy robots: hospitals, energy, construction, logistics, facilities, airports, ports, retail
3. Government innovation, smart-city and economic-development teams
4. Investors and accelerators covering MENA deep tech
5. Journalists and newsletter writers covering Gulf tech
Skip personal friends with no link to the field: invites they ignore don't help.

kit.title: What to pin
kit.note: Pinned posts are what new visitors see first.
kit.text:
X: pin the launch thread (Mon 16 Nov 09:00). From 7 Dec, pin the GITEX live thread instead, then switch back.
Instagram: pin the launch carousel (Mon 16 Nov) and the "How we verify" post.
LinkedIn: feature the launch carousel in the page's Featured section.
Reddit: pin (sticky) the welcome post in r/RoboticsMENA, and from 6 Dec the GITEX megathread as the second sticky.

kit.title: Accounts for @roboticsmena to follow on X (by hand)
kit.note: Following relevant accounts by hand is fine; follow/unfollow tactics are not. Follow 20 to 30 a day at most so X doesn't flag the new account.
kit.text:
Confirmed handles: @ADNOCGroup, @DXBMediaOffice, @rta_dubai, @WeRide_ai
Then: the official X accounts of the companies, operators and agencies in our database. Use the X link on each organisation's own website, not search results, so you follow the real account.

posts.text:
